title: Labubu Funk
blurb: Behind the great Labubu takeover was a beat, and this is it. Kasing Lung's fanged little creature went from niche designer toy to the most fought-over collectible on the planet — queues around blocks, resale prices detached from reality, celebrities photographed with one clipped to a handbag, and a fandom operating at genuinely concerning intensity. The funk track became the sound of unboxing videos and blind-box reveals everywhere. Play it in tribute to whatever you are currently overpaying for. The teeth, everyone agrees, are a significant part of the appeal.
origin: The funk track attached to the viral Labubu collectible craze.
